title: Crop evapotranspiration — Guidelines for computing crop water requirements
authors_or_org: Allen, R.G., Pereira, L.S., Raes, D., Smith, M. (FAO)
used_for: Penman-Monteith ET0 (Eq. 6-40), Hargreaves (Eq. 52), single Kc water balance (Ch. 6-8), depletion fraction p (Table 22)
notes: Cross-checked against FAO-56 Examples 2, 3, 5, 8, 9, 11, 17, 18 and scripts/crosscheck_et0.py

title: Yield response to water
authors_or_org: Doorenbos, J., Kassam, A.H. (FAO)
used_for: Seasonal yield response factor Ky: 1 - Ya/Ym = Ky(1 - ETa/ETc)
notes: Used in src/lib/engine/waterBalance.ts and src/lib/crops/database.ts

title: Crop yield response to water
authors_or_org: Steduto, P., Hsiao, T.C., Fereres, E., Raes, D. (FAO)
used_for: Updated Ky and water-limited yield parameters
notes: Used alongside FAO-33 in src/lib/crops/database.ts

title: Soil water characteristic estimates by texture and organic matter for hydrologic solutions
authors_or_org: Saxton, K.E., Rawls, W.J.
used_for: Pedotransfer functions Eq. 1-10 for thetaWP, thetaFC, thetaSat, Ksat and bulk-density adjustment
notes: Implemented and tested in src/lib/engine/soil.ts and src/lib/engine/soil.test.ts

title: Urban Hydrology for Small Watersheds (TR-55)
authors_or_org: USDA-NRCS
used_for: SCS Curve Number runoff method and Table 2-2b cover-dependent CN2 values
notes: Slope-adjusted using Williams (1995) EPIC / SWAT equation in src/lib/engine/soil.ts

title: NASA POWER Daily API (Agroclimatology Community)
authors_or_org: NASA Langley Research Center (LaRC) POWER Project
license: US Public Domain / NASA Open Data
used_for: Daily meteorology (T2M, T2M_MAX, T2M_MIN, RH2M, WS2M, ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN, PRECTOTCORR, GWETROOT, GWETTOP) 2001-present
notes: Bundled in 5 pilot snapshots (src/data/snapshots/*.json) and live via src/lib/data/power.ts

title: MODIS Global Subsets REST Web Service (MOD13Q1 v061)
authors_or_org: ORNL DAAC / NASA LP DAAC
license: US Public Domain / NASA Open Data
used_for: 16-day 250 m NDVI phenology series and quality filtering
notes: Implemented in src/lib/data/modis.ts

title: SoilGrids 2.0 global soil information
authors_or_org: ISRIC — World Soil Information (Poggio et al. 2021)
used_for: 6-layer soil profile (0-200 cm) sand, silt, clay, SOC, pH, CEC, nitrogen, BD, CFVO, wv0033, wv1500 and WRB group
notes: Implemented in src/lib/data/soilgrids.ts and src/lib/data/soillayers.ts

title: NASA SRTM v3.0 1 Arc-Second Global DEM via OpenTopoData
authors_or_org: NASA / JPL / NGA (served by OpenTopoData)
used_for: Field elevation mean/min/max, finite-difference slope (%) and aspect (deg)
notes: Implemented in src/lib/data/terrain.ts

title: ECMWF ERA5 / ERA5-Land Historical Weather API via Open-Meteo
authors_or_org: ECMWF Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) / Open-Meteo.com
used_for: 25-year independent precipitation cross-check against NASA POWER PRECTOTCORR
notes: Implemented in src/lib/data/precip.ts

title: GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 1 month 0.1 degree x 0.1 degree V07 (GPM_3IMERGM)
authors_or_org: Huffman, G.J. et al. / NASA GES DISC
license: US Public Domain / NASA Open Data
used_for: Optional monthly precipitation cross-check via OPeNDAP and NASA GIBS visualization layer

title: CARTO Voyager & Voyager Labels Retina (@2x) Basemap Tiles
authors_or_org: CARTO / OpenStreetMap contributors
used_for: High-DPI (@2x) Turkey street/settlement base map and transparent province/district/village label overlay up to native zoom 19

title: OpenTopoMap Global Topographic & Contour Tiles
authors_or_org: OpenTopoMap / OpenStreetMap contributors / NASA SRTM
used_for: Turkey topographic contour and elevation relief map up to native zoom 17
notes: Implemented in src/lib/data/tiles.ts

title: TMO 2025/2026 Hububat ve Mısır Alım Fiyatları, Trakya Birlik Ayçiçeği ve Türkşeker Şeker Pancarı Referans Alım Fiyatları
authors_or_org: Toprak Mahsulleri Ofisi (TMO), Trakya Birlik, Türkiye Şeker Fabrikaları A.Ş. (Türkşeker), Ticaret Borsaları
used_for: Varsayılan ürün alım fiyatları ve değişken üretim maliyeti kalibrasyonu (Buğday 14,50 TL/kg, Arpa 13,52 TL/kg destek dahil, Mısır 11,97 TL/kg destek dahil, Ayçiçeği 28,00 TL/kg, Nohut 38,00 TL/kg, Kırmızı Mercimek 34,00 TL/kg, Şeker Pancarı 3,40 TL/kg)

title: SMAP L4 Global 3-hourly 9 km EASE-Grid Surface and Root Zone Soil Moisture Geophysical Data (SPL4SMGP v007)
authors_or_org: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) / GMAO / NSIDC DAAC
license: US Public Domain / NASA Open Data
used_for: Regional surface (0-5 cm) and root-zone (0-100 cm) soil moisture wetness baseline and spatial resolution adequacy checks (9 km pixel = 8,100 ha)
notes: Integrated in src/lib/data-infra/sourcesCatalog.ts and src/lib/data-infra/repository.ts with explicit parcel-scale uncertainty warning.

title: NASA Earth Exchange Global Daily Downscaled Projections (NEX-GDDP-CMIP6)
authors_or_org: NASA Center for Climate Simulation (NCCS) / NASA Ames Research Center (Thrasher et al. 2022)
used_for: Conditional 3-year climate stress scenarios (SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5 temperature deltas and precipitation multipliers) for minimax-regret rotation optimization
notes: Strictly prohibited as a deterministic short-term weather forecast; implemented in src/lib/data-infra/turkishAgData.ts.

title: FAO AquaCrop Reference Manual Version 7.1 — Chapter 3: Crop Parameters
authors_or_org: Raes, D., Steduto, P., Hsiao, T.C., Fereres, E. (FAO)
used_for: Normalized water productivity WP* (C3 15-18 g/m2, C4 33.7 g/m2), reference harvest index HI0, canopy growth/decline coefficients CGC/CDC, and upper/lower water stress thresholds
notes: Implemented in src/lib/data-infra/aquacrop.ts and served via GET /api/crops/parameters.

notes: Implemented in src/lib/data-infra/turkishAgData.ts.

title: Türkiye'de Sulanan Bitkilerin Bitki Su Tüketimleri Rehberi (TAGEM-SuET)
